plan.notes: Official Rio Hondo College Guided Pathways sample education plan (pathways.riohondo.edu), 2026-2027 catalog year. The page's main sample plan is used (Cal-GETC pattern); the alternate Cal-GETC - Fully Online map in the page's dropdown is not modeled. Term-by-term sequence transcribed from the published program map. Total 60.5 units = sum of published pathway slots. All fixed courses on this map list only Advisories in their published descriptions; prereq arrays are intentionally empty — see the official catalog's course descriptions. Dagger (†): some classes may carry higher units; slots encoded at published values. Choice slots model the official 'Select one' requirements; see choice notes.

courses.title: Interpersonal Communication
courses.choice_note: Select one of COMM C1004 / COMM C1004H per the official map (marked M). COMM C1004 - Interpersonal Communication; COMM C1004H - Interpersonal Communication Honors.
